template_name: 折线图、条形图和双Y轴的复合时间序列图
plot_goal: 576 intervals on four prescribed dates; actual and causal price forecasts with signed forecast errors

column_mappings.template_role: One physical time-series panel per prescribed date
Actual price dark line, evaluation only
Active forecast blue line and error versus actual on secondary axis

required_preprocessing: Read fixed plotting copy; divide CNY by 1e6/1000 only for display; derive signed errors from observed columns
style_elements_to_preserve: Muted bars and clear foreground lines
elements_allowed_to_change: Replace demo series with real cost or price series
Remove fitted trends and significance claims
axis_plan: Calendar months or original hour boundaries; currency and price units
legend_plan: Distinct policy names, line styles and a separate upper legend band where needed
annotation_plan: Same realized tariff; causal inputs and internal assumptions
warnings: Internal assumptions; perfect-price policies omitted from plots of implementable policies.
